summary: SOS SMS-DELIVERY FIX VERIFIED end-to-end on web preview at 390x844. Registered a fresh Driver via UI (sostest_1785681098@t.com / test1234, role=user). Opened SOS via Home badge (testID='sos-button'). Regression (no contacts): SEND SOS button is correctly disabled when contacts=0 — no crash, safe UX. Added contact 'Alice / +919888877777' via testID='sos-name-input' + 'sos-phone-input' + 'sos-add-btn' — card testID='sos-contact-<id>' appeared. Tapped testID='send-sos-btn' — testID='sos-delivery-note' rendered with text 'Opening SMS app for 1 contact(s).' (the sms:-URI fallback path via Linking, which is the expected success outcome on web preview since expo-sms native composer is unavailable there). testID='sos-open-map' 'Alert logged' card also appears with a working map link. Deleted the contact via testID='delete-sos-<id>' — card disappeared. All 7/7 flow assertions passed. No deprecated Expo packages introduced; expo-sms is the current recommended module. No red screens, no console errors relevant to SOS.
critical_code_review_comments: sos.tsx correctly attempts SMS.isAvailableAsync() first (native composer path), then falls back to Linking.openURL('sms:...') with platform-specific separators (iOS '&body=' vs Android '?body='), and finally a preview-friendly note if neither works. This ordering matches expo-sms best practice.

The SEND SOS button is disabled when contacts.length === 0 (opacity 0.5 + disabled), so the 'No contacts to notify.' branch inside sendSos() is effectively dead code from the UI. Not a bug — the disabled state prevents crashes — but the review requested a 'No contacts to notify.' note. Consider either (a) enabling the button and letting the note show, or (b) inline text under the disabled button, if the exact-note-string regression is important to product. Reference: /app/frontend/app/sos.tsx:63-67 and :129.

Backend alert-log call is fire-then-SMS, so if the /api/sos/alert POST fails the SMS composer is still not opened (map_link becomes undefined). Acceptable trade-off but worth a fallback body without map_link on error. Reference: /app/frontend/app/sos.tsx:60-70.

Location fallback uses hardcoded Bangalore coordinates (12.9716, 77.5946) when permission is denied — this is a reasonable dev default but should be surfaced in the delivery note so a user isn't misled. Reference: /app/frontend/app/sos.tsx:46.
seed_data_creation: Registered one fresh Driver via UI: sostest_1785681098@t.com / test1234 (role=user, phone +919999999999, Sedan/KA01AB1234). Added and then deleted SOS contact 'Alice / +919888877777' during the test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SOS SMS delivery works on web preview via the sms:-URI Linking fallback (testID='sos-delivery-note' shows 'Opening SMS app for N contact(s).'). Real native SMS composer (SMS.sendSMSAsync) will only fire on a physical iOS/Android build — not testable via Playwright. Regression path 'No contacts to notify.' is currently unreachable from UI because the SEND SOS button is disabled at contacts.length===0; if product wants that exact string visible, enable the button when contacts=0 or move the note next to the disabled button. All other flows (register -> home sos badge -> add contact -> send sos -> alert-logged card -> delete contact) are green.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: 'SEND SOS ALERT' only logged the alert to backend; no SMS was actually delivered. Fix implemented in /app/frontend/app/sos.tsx: after POST /api/sos/alert, the app tries SMS.isAvailableAsync() -> SMS.sendSMSAsync(numbers, body) (opens native SMS composer on real devices), then falls back to Linking.openURL('sms:<numbers>?body=<url-encoded>') for cases where expo-sms is not available (dev clients / some web contexts), and finally shows an explanatory note in testID='sos-delivery-note' when neither path is possible. Verification on web preview (Playwright, 390x844): the second path (sms: URI via Linking) fired successfully and testID='sos-delivery-note' rendered 'Opening SMS app for 1 contact(s).' — confirming the fix wires SMS delivery correctly. testID='sos-open-map' 'Alert logged' card is unchanged and still works.
